# Vector of double instructions

The `.vecDouble` stack holds vectors of doubles. It shares its instruction families with the other vector types, and adds the numeric reductions.

<!-- Generated by Instruction Reference Tests from the language itself: do not edit. -->

## Operations

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vecDoubleAdd` | Adds element by element: `a b .vecDoubleAdd` gives a[i] and b[i] combined, where b is the top vector of doubles and a the first one below it of the same length (a miss if there is none); refuses a result that is not finite, naming the index. | `vecDouble`, the topmost fitting `vecDouble` | `vecDouble`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleButLast` | Drops the last element; an empty vector stays empty. | `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleChunks` | Chunks: `v n .vecDoubleChunks` gives a block of the vectors of n consecutive elements, the last possibly shorter (n below 1 counts as 1). | `vecDouble`, `int` | `code`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleConcat` | Joins two vectors: `a b .vecDoubleConcat` gives the elements of a followed by those of b. | `vecDouble`, `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleConj` | Appends a double: `v x .vecDoubleConj` gives v with x added at the end. | `vecDouble`, `double` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleConstruct` | Builds a vector of the top n doubles, consuming them, where n is the length of a template vector, also consumed; the top double comes last. | `vecDouble`, n × `double` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleContains` | Tells whether x is an element: `v x .vecDoubleContains`, leaving both. | `vecDouble` (read), `double` (read) | `bool` |
| `vecDoubleContainsRun` | Tells whether a run occurs: `v w .vecDoubleContainsRun` asks if v holds w contiguously, leaving both; an empty w always matches. | `vecDouble` (read), `vecDouble` (read) | `bool` |
| `vecDoubleCut` | Splits at a gap: `v i .vecDoubleCut` pushes the first i elements, then the rest on top, i clamped to 0 through the length. | `vecDouble`, `int` | `vecDouble`, `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleDifference` | Filters: `a b .vecDoubleDifference` keeps the elements of a that do not occur in b, in a's order, repeats included. | `vecDouble`, `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleDistinct` | Removes repeated elements, keeping each first occurrence in order. | `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleDivide` | Divides (a ÷ b) element by element: `a b .vecDoubleDivide` gives a[i] and b[i] combined, where b is the top vector of doubles and a the first one below it of the same length (a miss if there is none); refuses a result that is not finite, naming the index. | `vecDouble`, the topmost fitting `vecDouble` | `vecDouble`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleDot` | Pushes the dot product of two vectors of doubles, the sum of a[i] × b[i]: `a b .vecDoubleDot`, where b is the top vector and a the first one below it of the same length (a miss if there is none); leaves both; empty vectors give 0; refuses a result that is not finite. | `vecDouble` (read), the topmost fitting `vecDouble` (read) | `double`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleDrop` | Drops the front: `v n .vecDoubleDrop` removes the first n elements, n clamped to 0 through the length. | `vecDouble`, `int` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleDropLast` | Drops the back: `v n .vecDoubleDropLast` removes the last n elements, n clamped to 0 through the length. | `vecDouble`, `int` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleEq` | Pushes whether the top two vectors of doubles are equal, leaving both. | `vecDouble` (read), `vecDouble` (read) | `bool` |
| `vecDoubleEqEach` | Pushes whether each element of a is equal to the matching element of b: `a b .vecDoubleEqEach`, where b is the top vector of doubles and a the first one below it of the same length (a miss if there is none); leaves both. | `vecDouble` (read), the topmost fitting `vecDouble` (read) | `vecBool` |

| `vecDoubleFirst` | Pushes the first element, consuming the vector; refuses an empty vector. | `vecDouble` | `double`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleFrequencies` | Counts each distinct element: gives the distinct elements in ascending order, then a vector of ints with how many times each occurs. | `vecDouble` | `vecDouble`, `vecInt` |

| `vecDoubleIndexOfRun` | Finds a run: `v w .vecDoubleIndexOfRun` gives where w first occurs contiguously in v, leaving both; an empty w gives 0; refuses when absent. | `vecDouble` (read), `vecDouble` (read) | `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleInterleave` | Interleaves: `a b .vecDoubleInterleave` gives a[0] b[0] a[1] b[1] …, then the rest of the longer. | `vecDouble`, `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleIntersect` | Filters: `a b .vecDoubleIntersect` keeps the elements of a that also occur in b, in a's order, repeats included. | `vecDouble`, `vecDouble` | `vecDouble` |

| `vecDoubleLT` | Compares lexicographically (a prefix sorts first), leaving both: `a b .vecDoubleLT` gives a < b; a NaN sorts above every number. | `vecDouble` (read), `vecDouble` (read) | `bool` |

| `vecDoubleLTEach` | Pushes whether each element of a is less than the matching element of b: `a b .vecDoubleLTEach`, where b is the top vector of doubles and a the first one below it of the same length (a miss if there is none); leaves both. | `vecDouble` (read), the topmost fitting `vecDouble` (read) | `vecBool` |
| `vecDoubleLast` | Pushes the last element, consuming the vector; refuses an empty vector. | `vecDouble` | `double`; may refuse |

| `vecDoubleMap` | Maps the topmost function on `.function` that fits over a vector of doubles, each element in its first double hole; refuses when none fits, filler runs short, results are mixed or steps run out. | `vecDouble`, the topmost fitting `function` | `vecBool` or `vecDouble` or `vecInt` or `vecString` or `string`; may refuse |

| `vecDoubleLookupContaining` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that contains it as a run, pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleLookupContainingFrom` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that contains it as a run, searching from depth i (at least 1), pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `int`, `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleLookupEqual` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that equals it, pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleLookupEqualFrom` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that equals it, searching from depth i (at least 1), pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `int`, `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleLookupPrefix` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that begins with it, pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleLookupPrefixFrom` | Reads the top vector of doubles as a probe and copies the topmost one below that begins with it, searching from depth i (at least 1), pushing its depth + 1 onto `.int`; refuses on a miss. | `int`, `vecDouble` (read) | `vecDouble`, `int`; may refuse |
| `vecDoubleReadItems` | Copies the top n doubles into a vector, leaving them: `n .vecDoubleReadItems`, n clamped to the stack's depth; the top double comes last. | `int` | `vecDouble` |
| `vecDoubleReadStack` | Copies the whole double stack into a vector, leaving it; the bottom double comes first, and an empty stack gives an empty vector. | — | `vecDouble` |

## Control

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vecDoubleIterate` | Loops over the vector: for each element, pushes it to the double stack and runs the block taken from `.code`, which returns there afterward. | `vecDouble`, `code` | the rest of the program |
| `vecDoubleWith` | Binds a copy of the top vector of doubles to a fresh key, runs a body block from `.code` with the key on `.int`, then removes the binding. | `code`, `vecDouble` (read) | the rest of the program |

## Output

| Instruction | What it does | Takes | Gives |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vecDoublePrint` | Prints the top vector of doubles and a newline to the output. | `vecDouble` | the printout |

## The stack's own instructions

Every stack has the same family for copying, deleting, reordering and measuring its items; see <doc:StackInstructions>. On `.vecDouble` they are `vecDoubleDeepDup`, `vecDoubleDeleteAtDepth`, `vecDoubleDup`, `vecDoubleDupItems`, `vecDoubleDupTimes`, `vecDoubleFlush`, `vecDoublePop`, `vecDoublePopItems`, `vecDoubleRot`, `vecDoubleShove`, `vecDoubleStackDepth`, `vecDoubleStackIsEmpty`, `vecDoubleSwap`, `vecDoubleYank`, `vecDoubleYankDup`.
